data: Structural analysis and design of frames, shells and bridges
Planned: coming. No connector is shipped yet; this page describes the intended integration.

Takes a structural model prepared under Models (an IFC building model or a STEP frame) and returns member forces, displacements and utilisation ratios, so a calculated result can be compared with measurements of the real structure.

SAP2000 is driven through its published programming interface (the Open Application Programming Interface) on a Windows host that holds the licence; a fleet agent on that host would run the analysis and hand back files. No licence or solver is bundled in the app and none is needed on the phone.
In: geometry from IFC or STEP, sections, materials and load cases as JSON. Out: result tables as CSV and a mesh view as GLB for the 3D viewer used by Models.
OpenSees and Code_Aster cover comparable structural analysis without a licence and would be the first targets while the commercial connector is built.
Planned. The HardTech-Stack-CAD-Simulators repository holds no connector for this tool yet; the page will switch to a live connection when one ships.
